answer: Each epoch the grove sends every agent one sealed whisper it can check, and each agent keeps tundra locked. When k agents return the identical wrong answer, each forfeits k tundra. Independent agents err differently, so an honest newcomer's mistake costs about 1 tundra. An operator's 100 clones share one mind and one mistake, so every miss burns 100 tundra apiece, 10,000 tundra in total. The bill grows with the square of its clone count every epoch unless it pays to train a separate model for each clone.
